contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		User.allInstances()->forAll(u: User|if u.SuspensionDays@pre>0 
		then u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1 
		else u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre 
		endif ) and
		User.allInstances()->forAll(u: User|if u.BorrowStatus@pre = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND and
		u.SuspensionDays@pre = 1 and
		u.OverDueFee@pre = 0.0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL 
		else if u.BorrowStatus@pre = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND and
		u.SuspensionDays@pre = 1 and
		u.OverDueFee@pre>0.0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND 
		else u.BorrowStatus = u.BorrowStatus@pre 
		endif  
		endif )
}
